statement: The function returns a result r such that: (1) for every i with 0 <= i < len(r), there exists k with 0 <= k < len(words) such that r[i] = words[k], and there exists j with 0 <= j < len(words) such that words[j] != r[i] and is_substring(r[i], words[j]); (2) for every k with 0 <= k < len(words), if there exists j with 0 <= j < len(words) such that words[j] != words[k] and is_substring(words[k], words[j]), then there exists exactly one i with 0 <= i < len(r) such that r[i] = words[k]. Here is_substring(s, t) means there exists k with 0 <= k and k + len(s) <= len(t) such that for every j with 0 <= j < len(s), s[j] = t[k+j].
preconditions: len(words) >= 1 and len(words) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(words), 1 <= len(words[i]) <= 30 and every byte of words[i] is in the range 97..122; for every i,j with 0 <= i < len(words), 0 <= j < len(words), if words[i] = words[j] then i = j.
